s1.desc: an igloo room with pale ice-brick walls

spans.notes: Exterior, icy winding road through snow: a red car drives in from the bottom right and away into the distance, stops, Pax looks back, reverse lights come on, the car backs up. Camera locked (tree region shift 0 for f1-125) but Pax is only the back of his head above the car seat, and from ~f30 on a speck about 4% of the frame high. Licence plate text on the car. Judged too little of the lead to caption him.

Pull-back that reveals the road was seen through a round igloo window, with Polly in the foreground watching; the window frame and side table keep drifting until the cut (compare 141/152 doubled). A phone lies on the side table.

spans.view: with a round window over a small white side table and an arched wooden door

beats.text: Polly stands at the round window with her back turned, peering outside with her flippers raised to her beak
Pax pushes the wooden door open and steps inside, holding the door with one flipper, while Polly keeps looking out
Polly turns around from the window, clasps her flippers at her chest and closes her eyes in a happy smile
Pax stretches his free flipper toward Polly with worried brows while she spreads her flippers wide

spans.notes: Static: compare 153/199 (window, table edges black; the door moves because it opens). A phone lies on the side table, untouched. | verification pass 2 (verify3_report_1): Beat 193-200 says Pax 'smiles at her from the doorway'. spans.view: with a round window, a small white side table and an arched wooden door

beats.text: Polly hurries in from the left while Pax hurries over from the right, both with their flippers open
Pax and Polly hug each other tightly with their eyes closed and happy smiles
